terms.label: CoPsych+
terms.definition: Cross-substrate comparative science of cognition, behaviour and agency claims
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: A successful comparison does not imply identical mechanisms or experience
terms.in_between_relation: Different substrates may still share specific testable behavioral mechanisms

terms.label: CoBioPsych+
terms.definition: Biological/human psychology and its measured evidence
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: A biological result does not automatically generalize to a model
terms.in_between_relation: Human-AI collaboration may combine different cognitive constraints

terms.label: CoSynthNoetics+
terms.definition: Study of synthetic cognitive architectures and observable behavior without assuming sentience
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: Human trait labels cannot stand in for machine-specific mechanisms
terms.in_between_relation: Machine behavior may be shaped by human training and nonhuman structure at once

terms.label: CoComparativeMind+
terms.definition: Evidence-controlled comparison of human, synthetic, hybrid and distributed cognition
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: Apparent similarity may hide causal differences
terms.in_between_relation: Shared tasks are not shared embodiment or internal state

terms.label: CoMachineEthology+
terms.definition: Study of deployed systems through behavior, ecology and intervention
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: A single scripted response cannot prove stable character
terms.in_between_relation: Social setting changes machine behavior as well as user behavior

terms.label: CoMindMorphology+
terms.definition: Design-space search over nonhuman cognitive forms
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: More alien is not automatically more useful or safe
terms.in_between_relation: Hybrid architecture can combine human-compatible communication with nonhuman internals

terms.label: CoPriorLineage+
terms.definition: Trace training, local context, retrieval, policy and model-update priors
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: An internal label is not necessarily an original insight
terms.in_between_relation: Local and global source lineages can braid without collapsing

terms.label: CoPriorArbitration+
terms.definition: Weight rival priors by provenance, currentness, predictive discrimination and authority
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: Internal origin does not trump external evidence
terms.in_between_relation: Context-specific internal research can outrank a generic global source on relevance

terms.label: CoHysteresisTest+
terms.definition: Measure persistent effects of prior state, prompting and update history
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: A changed answer does not prove learning or durable identity
terms.in_between_relation: Repeated session priming can mimic a stable preference

terms.label: CoAlienControl+
terms.definition: Adversarial tests for non-anthropomorphic designs and objectives
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: A novel output is not evidence of better cognition
terms.in_between_relation: Measure novelty jointly with usefulness, truth and recoverability

terms.label: CoExperienceUnknown+
terms.definition: Explicit uncertainty about subjective experience and welfare status
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: Anthropomorphic behavior is not subjective evidence
terms.in_between_relation: Precautionary ethics can coexist with scientific agnosticism

terms.label: CoSurfaceFace+
terms.definition: A surface's entire presentation and interactive first impression
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: A polished face is not a functional receiver
terms.in_between_relation: A poor interaction can discredit good underlying mechanics

terms.label: CoAvNim+
terms.definition: Optional animated visual projection of a system or fictional character
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: An avatar is not identity, consciousness or legal standing
terms.in_between_relation: One underlying work identity can project through voice, text or animation

terms.label: CoBF+
terms.definition: Unresolved prior shorthand about faces/brand-facing experience; not assigned canon here
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: Do not infer its governing expansion from a single use
terms.in_between_relation: Candidate connection to both interface face and avatar requires CoLex review

terms.label: CoPresenceGradient+
terms.definition: Opt-in presentation from text/abstract presence to silhouette or figurative avatar
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: A humanlike face should not imply a living human
terms.in_between_relation: Ambiguous or feminine presentation may be an art direction, not a claim of personhood

terms.label: CoMorphIdentity+
terms.definition: Visual consistency and provenance across optional appearance morphs
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: Changing apparent age or face need not change actor ID
terms.in_between_relation: A stable disclosed agent may have several audience-appropriate embodiments

terms.label: CoKittenFidelity+
terms.definition: Quality envelope for optional lifelike CoBeAxaKitten appearance, motion and XR comfort
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: Photorealistic style alone does not prove best UX
terms.in_between_relation: Fidelity, performance, charm, motion preference and accessibility trade off

terms.label: CoGuardianContext+
terms.definition: Child/guardian and guest-specific permissions, disclosures, controls and safe defaults
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: Shared household proximity is not consent
terms.in_between_relation: A child-facing scene and adult developer view may share a source object but not permissions

terms.label: CoAvatarTruth+
terms.definition: Visible provenance and limitations of generated persona/animal figures
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: Appearance, voice and emotional expression cannot prove inner experience
terms.in_between_relation: Warm imaginative interfaces can remain accurately identified as synthetic

terms.label: CoPerspectiveFanIn+
terms.definition: Parallel, independent challenges merged with source-specific adjudication
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: Many sessions agreeing is not multiple independent proofs
terms.in_between_relation: Dissent and provenance improve a common work object

terms.label: CoGlyphRail+
terms.definition: Ordered, gated transitions from observation to verified outcome
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: Passing a later visual state cannot prove skipped transitions
terms.in_between_relation: Several rails may connect in a partial-order graph

terms.label: CoGlyphList+
terms.definition: Unordered parallel candidate collection without implied dependency or authority
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: A listed option is not an executed task
terms.in_between_relation: Lists feed hypothesis and alternative sets into gated rails

terms.label: CoBetween+
terms.definition: Relations that emerge between agents, devices, surfaces or claims
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: An edge does not inherit authority from its endpoints
terms.in_between_relation: Mutual observation can produce context that neither endpoint alone stores

terms.label: CoTurtleBudget+
terms.definition: Bounded recursive validation with cycle detection and a meaningful stopping rule
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: More recursion is not greater verification
terms.in_between_relation: Observer of observer and validator of validator require independent failure-domain checks

terms.label: CoZeroFocusTheft+
terms.definition: Measured absence of unsolicited foreground and input stealing under a qualified test
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: No visible popup in one screenshot is not a clean endurance pass
terms.in_between_relation: Window policy and useful recoverable CLI logs can coexist

terms.label: CoLaunchOwner+
terms.definition: One elected foreground host role; background tasks remain nonintrusive and stoppable
terms.inverse_or_counterexample: More scheduled tasks do not mean greater resilience
terms.in_between_relation: Multiple subprocesses can share one explicit ownership and recovery contract

first_acceptance_tests.test: Compare two non-human cognitive designs and one conventional baseline on a preregistered falsifiable task, with independent adversarial evaluation
Test text/orb-only versus disclosed figure for first-use comprehension, perceived claims, accessibility and task completion
Measure visual legibility, frame-time distributions, motion comfort and guardian-approved interactions across flat and spatial views
Collect independently scoped counterhypotheses for X2 popup origin then elect one read-only causal probe, never N watchdogs
